Stream thumbnails

Key art and title cards for VTuber streams and collabs

Thumbnails have to work small and in a crowded feed, so each one leads with faces, a strong silhouette and one clear idea — the setting, the game, or the joke — rather than fine detail.

Mago Hago

Original designer toy brand — character design, logo, colorways

One silhouette, a set of swappable faces, and a growing cast of colorways. The proportions got pushed until the head could carry an expression on its own, so the same body reads as a different character every time the face changes.

The flat design was then built as a 3D model so it holds up as a physical charm — round enough to print cleanly, with the ears and feet thick enough to survive being carried around.

Holiday set

Character design, icon set, seamless repeat patterns

One snowman body, restyled with a hat, earmuffs, a scarf or a pair of star eyes, plus a tree, gifts and a set of snowflakes — then tiled three ways. Each repeat changes only the background colour and the density, so the set holds together across a whole product range.

Princess Party

Video game in development — art direction, character design & UI

The idea

A cozy, character-driven party game about princesses — pastel castles, big feelings, and a frog who tags along.

My role

Everything visual: key art, character design, and the game's interface, drawn to match the cartoon look of the animation.

Status

In development — follow along as the cast grows.
